slides.heading: Arguments
slides.body: Arguments is part of Functions and Modularity. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Arguments
slides.body: An argument is the actual value sent into a function call. It fills the parameter when the function runs.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: An argument is like the information you write into a form blank.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A good function should do one clear task and have a name that explains that task.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Call add with two numbers so it prints 10.
slides.hint: Use add(4, 6) or another pair that sums to 10.
